canvas.$description: Canvas — Page backgrounds, form surfaces, image backgrounds — the silent stage on which all content sits

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icons, hairline borders, button outlines, checkbox marks, form labels

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary/helper text, placeholder text, disabled labels — the only mid-tone that breaks the binary

helvetica-now-text.$description: All UI text — form labels, dropdowns, buttons, body copy, helper text, links. The deliberately compressed size range (11–16px) gives every screen an editorial-print feel; body copy at 11–13px is anti-convention for digital, making the interface feel like a magazine layout rather than a software product.
